title: Greatest Sum Divisible by Three
summary: Given an integer array, find the highest sum of its elements that is divisible by three.
statement: Given an integer array, find the highest sum of its elements that is divisible by three.
constraints: Choose any subset of positive integers.
Return the greatest possible subset sum divisible by three.
The empty subset is allowed and has sum zero.
hints: Track the best sum for each remainder modulo three.
For every value, transition from a snapshot of the three previous states.
Update the remainder of total plus value and return remainder zero.
Every subset either excludes or includes the current value exactly once, and only its remainder matters for future choices.
editorial: Every subset either excludes or includes the current value exactly once, and only its remainder matters for future choices.

tests.explanation: Choosing three, six, five, one, and eight except five gives eighteen.
Four is not divisible by three, so the empty subset gives zero.
